links.effect: Mean decrease of two grade levels; FKGL 8.3 to 6.0, SMOG 8.1 to 6.1 (both P<.001); other formulas remained above sixth grade (ARI 7.1, GFI 8.6, CLI 8.0, LWF 7.1).

links.outcome: Whether ChatGPT-4 rewriting produces plain-language patient education material
links.effect: Mean FRE rose from 61.6 to 76.9 (P<.001); grade-level scores fell across all six formulas; word count fell from 728.3 to 303.6.
links.quote: The mean (± SD) FRE in the pre- and post-ChatGPT-4–edited text samples was 61.6 (±7.5) and 76.9 (± 8.2), respectively ( P < .001).

links.outcome: Automated readability of patient education materials
links.effect: FRE increased 61.6 (±7.5) to 76.9 (± 8.2), P < .001; mean word count decreased 728.3 to 303.6, P < .001.
links.quote: The mean (± SD) FRE in the pre- and post-ChatGPT-4–edited text samples was 61.6 (±7.5) and 76.9 (± 8.2), respectively ( P < .001).
